info.name: TradeDropCollection
info.description:
TradeDrop consumer APIs (from /api/v1/docs/openapi.json) + legacy Admin Panel utilities.

**Base URL env var `url`:** `http://localhost:4020/api/v1/` (trailing slash required)

**Auth:** collection Bearer `{{token}}` — Login/Register/Verify OTP scripts save token + otp.

**IDs:** set `categoryId`, `dropId`, `tapInId`, `tradeId`, `portfolioId`, `handle` after list/create calls.

item.description: This folder contains the chat-related API endpoints for the application. It includes sending a new message to a chat, retrieving a paginated list of all chat conversations, and fetching the message history for a specific chat filtered by job and object identifiers. These endpoints support pagination through `page` and `limit` query parameters.

request.description:
### Send Email

This endpoint allows you to send an email to the specified recipients.

#### Request Body

- title (string, optional): The title of the email.
    
- emails (array of strings): The list of email addresses to which the email will be sent.
    
- subject (string, required): The subject of the email.
    
- body (string, required): The body content of the email.
    
- config (object):
    
    - fromEmail (string, required): The sender's email address.
        
    - isHtml (boolean, required): Indicates whether the email body is in HTML format.
        

#### Response

The response is in JSON format with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "message": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

 ```
